title: Heading of Settings › Inference: which AI model the person's chats run on, and the AI subscriptions (such as a ChatGPT plan) they can connect. "Inference" is the technical term for running an AI model.
active: {{model}} is the model's or subscription's name. The base form: the model the workspace's operator set up; _byo (bring your own): a subscription the person connected themselves.
noKinds: Shown when the server offers no subscriptions to connect. _noModel: and the person's chats have no model at all; an operator is the person who runs this server.
list: Accessible name of the list of subscriptions (read by screen readers).
state.pending: Status badge while a sign-in to the subscription is in progress.
state.error: Status badge when the connection has a problem; short.
cancel: Button: stop a sign-in in progress.
code: Before a one-time code the person types on the provider's sign-in page (device sign-in).
openSignIn: Link to the provider's sign-in page, where the person enters the code.
disconnected: Toast after a subscription was disconnected.
state.connected: A subscription's status badge: signed in and usable.
